reasons.detail: the model is a 'forecasting_baseline'; candidate fan_speed_rpm values cannot be evaluated: fan_speed_rpm @ 5 min: independent step changes are followed by the expected inlet response (sign -1, |NW t| >= 3.0) in only 0 of 35 assets (needs >= 80%) | fan_speed_rpm @ 10 min: independent step changes are followed by the expected inlet response (sign -1, |NW t| >= 3.0) in only 0 of 35 assets (needs >= 80%)
no measured cooling-system power exists in the telemetry (power_consumption_kw is per-server IT power); energy-optimal selection is impossible
optimizer.setting_min and setting_max (and search_step for the grid search) must be set from verified equipment limits

actuation: none: this system only recommends; it never sends commands to equipment
warnings: Trained and evaluated on SIMULATED telemetry only; offline metrics are not evidence of physical validity.
Forecast under observed conditions only; it does not predict the effect of changing any cooling setting.
Model label 'forecasting_baseline': the response to cooling settings is not validated.
